    , policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Identifier AS policy

    SELECT
      Policy_Amount_Identifier AS policy_amount

) subq_5

) AND (
  metric_time__day >= '2019-01-01'
) AND (
  metric_time__day < '2020-01-01'
)
GROUP BY
  policy

results.name: heldout-unanswerable-what-was-the-renewal-retention-rate-for-policies-0dbb38
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 2 ms
answer.sql:
WITH holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.Agreement_Identifier, r.Party_Identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" r
  WHERE r.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%holder%'
),
expiring AS (
  SELECT p.Policy_Identifier, p.Expiration_Date
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p
  WHERE p.Expiration_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND p.Expiration_Date <= DATE '2019-12-31'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    e.Policy_Identifier,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM holders h1
      JOIN holders h2 ON h2.Party_Identifier = h1.Party_Identifier
      JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" n ON n.Policy_Identifier = h2.Agreement_Identifier
      WHERE h1.Agreement_Identifier = e.Policy_Identifier
        AND n.Policy_Identifier <> e.Policy_Identifier
        AND n.Effective_Date >= e.Expiration_Date
        AND n.Effective_Date <= e.Expiration_Date + 30
    ) AS renewed
  FROM expiring e
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS policies_expiring_2019,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE renewed) AS renewed_policies,
  CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE renewed) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS renewal_retention_rate
FROM flagged
LIMIT 501

answer.sql:
SELECT
  policy__party_identifier_dim
  , SUM(number_of_policies) AS number_of_policies
FROM (
  SELECT
    agreement_party_role_src_10000.party_identifier AS policy__party_identifier_dim
    , agreement_party_role_src_10000.party_role_code AS policy__party_role_code
    , subq_1.__number_of_policies AS number_of_policies
  FROM (
    SELECT
      Policy_Identifier AS policy
      , 1 AS __number_of_policies
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" policy_src_10000
  ) subq_1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" agreement_party_role_src_10000
  ON
    subq_1.policy = agreement_party_role_src_10000.agreement_identifier
) subq_5
WHERE policy__party_role_code = 'AG'
GROUP BY
  policy__party_identifier_dim
ORDER BY number_of_policies DESC
LIMIT 1
